summary: Morgan County, TN 60-ft Aermotor tower, moved from Walden Mountain, sold by state forestry in 1994 and restored privately in 1998; now on a private farm.

facts.status_note: Tennessee Landforms lists it as standing with no date; the Register describes a 1998 restoration; no later report of its condition found

access.note: On Windswept Farm, which the Register describes as private ownership; no public access described

events.note: Tennessee Forestry Division sold the tower; the Register does not give the date it was moved from Walden Mountain
New private owners completed reconstruction and restoration

notes_for_editor: Location conflict left open: Tennessee Landforms gives 36.1499,-84.7282 and 1,506 ft (459 m); the Register gives N 35.93667, W 84.06655 and 958 ft (292 m). The record's coordinates and elevation_m were not changed. Height 18.3 m is converted from 60 ft. Owner names in the Register were left out of the story and quotes. Used 2 WebSearch and 4 page reads. The NPGallery Tennessee Division of Forestry fire lookout MPS PDF (64501237) covers ten other towers and does not mention Windswept. No recent source on condition or public access was found.
